**Step 1 — Scene:** A pizza meal with a leafy side salad, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and a black olive.

**Step 2 — Vessel:** A large, rounded-square dinner plate, partly cropped. I estimate its usable area as equivalent to a **28 cm diameter** round plate:  
3.14 × 14² = **615 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Cheese-and-tomato pizza pieces; mixed salad leaves; broccoli; cherry tomatoes; one black olive; a light oil/dressing sheen. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate.

**Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Plate area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese-and-tomato pizza | 38% | 234 cm² × 1.2 cm = 281 ml | 0.9 | 253 g | 260 | 658 kcal |
| Mixed salad leaves | 18% | 111 cm² × 2 cm = 222 ml | 0.15 | 33 g | 20 | 7 kcal |
| Broccoli | 6% | 37 cm² × 2 cm = 74 ml | 0.55 | 41 g | 35 | 14 kcal |
| Cherry tomatoes | 6% | 37 cm² × 1.8 cm = 67 ml | 0.65 | 43 g | 20 | 9 kcal |
| Black olive | 0.7% | 4.3 cm² × 1.5 cm = 6.5 ml | 0.7 | 5 g | 115 | 6 kcal |
| Oil/light dressing | Overlaps vegetables | Thin coating, approximately 4 ml | 0.9 | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

Food covers approximately **69% of the plate**. Dressing overlaps the vegetables rather than adding separate coverage.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **379 g and 729 kcal** is plausible for the visible pizza pieces and modest vegetable sides. Most energy comes from the pizza; the dressing quantity is particularly uncertain.
